Imiglucerase dominates products, and Gaucher disease represents the largest therapeutic condition.

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean down

reasons.en: puts richer than calls by -2.2 vol pts vs peers — protection strongly bid
reasons.zh: 看跌比看涨贵 -2.2 个波动点（相对同业） — 保护性看跌被大力买入

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: Robbins LLP Reminds ALAR Stockholders of the Pending October 5, 2026 Lead Plaintiff Deadline in the Securities Class Action Against Alarum Technologies Ltd.
top.summary: A securities class action has been filed against Alarum Technologies Ltd. for allegedly making materially false and misleading statements regarding anti-money laundering compliance and regulatory risks. The lawsuit centers on undisclosed illegal activities by subsidiary NetNut Ltd., which linked customer home internet devices to networks without consent, enabling cybercriminals to conceal their locations. Following Reuters and Bloomberg reports on July 2-4, 2026, Alarum's stock collapsed 51.49% in a single trading session. Investors who purchased ALAR securities between March 20, 2025 and July 2, 2026 may be eligible to participate, with a lead plaintiff deadline of October 5, 2026.

top.title: 2026 Global Open-source AI Challenge Grand Finals and Awards Ceremony Held in Hangzhou
top.summary: The Global Open-source AI Challenge concluded its Grand Finals in Hangzhou on September 22-23, 2026, attracting over 14,000 developers from 91 countries with 2,999 submissions. top.title: BABA 9-DAY DEADLINE ALERT: Alibaba Group Holding Limited Investors with Substantial Losses Have Opportunity to Lead Shareholder Class Action Lawsuit Before October 5, 2026 Lead Plaintiff Deadline

top.title: Robbins LLP Reminds BABA Stockholders of the Pending October 5, 2026 Lead Plaintiff Deadline in the Securities Class Action Against Alibaba Group Holding Limited

The lawsuit also alleges Alibaba engaged in unauthorized distillation attacks on AI models. BABA stock dropped significantly following the Department of Defense's inclusion of Alibaba on a Chinese military companies list in June 2026 and subsequent reports of AI model theft. Investors who purchased BABA between June 26, 2025 and June 24, 2026 may be eligible to participate, with a lead plaintiff deadline of October 5, 2026.

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. Growth is driven by early identification of rare lysosomal storage disorders, increased newborn screening, orphan drug incentives, and expanding healthcare access. North America leads with 38.76% market share, while Asia-Pacific shows the fastest growth at 9.43% CAGR. Imiglucerase dominates products, and Gaucher disease represents the largest therapeutic condition.

The collection fuses traditional Chinese intangible cultural heritage—including fan-inspired silhouettes and Song brocade silk—with modern down-filling technology. The brand has grown from eight sewing machines in 1998 to holding 1,773 patents, operating in 72 countries, and serving over 200 million customers worldwide.

top.title: Europe Grid-Scale Battery Market Report 2026-2031 | Renewable Integration and Energy Storage Demand Accelerate
top.summary: Europe's grid-scale battery market is expanding from pilot projects to system-level deployment, valued at USD 2.34 billion in 2025. Growth is driven by renewable energy integration, regulatory reforms, energy security concerns, and grid congestion management. Lithium-ion batteries lead the market, with third-party ownership as the dominant model. Germany leads Europe's market due to its advanced infrastructure and renewable capacity. Key challenges include regulatory fragmentation, raw material dependency, and permitting delays.

top.title: BZAI INVESTOR DEADLINE APPROACHING: Faruqi & Faruqi, LLP Reminds Blaize Investors of Securities Class Action Lawsuit Deadline on October 5, 2026
top.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against Blaize Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BZAI) alleging that the company made false and misleading statements about revenue recognition and announced transactions with unequipped entities to artificially boost growth. The allegations were highlighted by a Pelican Way Research report on April 28, 2026, which claimed Blaize engaged in a bogus deal with a 4-month-old counterparty, causing the stock to fall 12.03% that day. Investors who purchased Blaize securities between July 18, 2025 and April 28, 2026 have until October 5, 2026 to seek lead plaintiff status.

top.title: BLAIZE HOLDINGS DEADLINE: ROSEN, A LEADING LAW FIRM, Encourages Blaize Holdings, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action First Filed by the Firm - BZAI
top.summary: Rosen Law Firm reminds investors who purchased Blaize Holdings (BZAI) securities between July 18, 2025 and April 28, 2026 of the October 5, 2026 lead plaintiff deadline in an ongoing securities class action. The lawsuit alleges that Blaize made false statements about business transactions, improperly recognized revenue, and misled investors about company growth.

top.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges Blaize Holdings, Inc. Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm

The complaint claims the company made materially false statements and failed to disclose that it announced transactions with unequipped entities to create false growth appearance, improperly recognized revenue, and issued inaccurate offering materials regarding receivables and inventory for the NeoTensr delivery.

top.title: CAPR 2-DAY DEADLINE ALERT: Capricor Therapeutics, Inc. Investors with Substantial Losses Have Opportunity to Lead Shareholder Class Action Lawsuit Before September 28, 2026 Deadline
top.summary: Capricor Therapeutics faces a securities class action lawsuit alleging materially misleading statements regarding clinical trial data for its lead drug candidate deramiocel. The company's stock crashed 64% after FDA briefing documents revealed undisclosed modifications to the statistical analysis plan for the HOPE-3 study, which failed to meet pre-specified primary and secondary efficacy endpoints. Investors with losses between December 17, 2025, and July 26, 2026, have until September 28, 2026, to seek lead plaintiff status.

top.title: CAPR INVESTOR DEADLINE APPROACHING: Faruqi & Faruqi, LLP Reminds Capricor Investors of Securities Class Action Lawsuit Deadline on September 28, 2026
top.summary: Faruqi & Faruqi, LLP is investigating securities fraud claims against Capricor Therapeutics for allegedly making misleading statements about its Deramiocel drug's regulatory prospects. The company allegedly failed to disclose changes to its statistical analysis plan and lack of FDA agreement before resubmitting the Biologics License Application. Capricor's stock plummeted 64% on July 27, 2026, after the FDA released unfavorable briefing documents, and fell an additional 36% on July 30, 2026, following an AdCom panel's 9-3 vote against the drug's efficacy. Investors who purchased securities between December 17, 2025 and July 26, 2026 may be eligible to participate in the class action lawsuit, with a September 28, 2026 deadline to seek lead plaintiff status.

top.title: C4 Therapeutics Presents New Biomarker Data from the Cemsidomide Phase 1 Trial with Dexamethasone and Phase 1b Trial with Elranatamab (ELREXFIO®) in Relapsed/Refractory Multiple Myeloma at the 23rd International Myeloma Society (IMS) Annual Meeting
top.summary: C4 Therapeutics presented biomarker data from its Phase 1 trial of cemsidomide combined with dexamethasone in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma patients, demonstrating robust T-cell activation and immune cell function. The company also shared preliminary data from a Phase 1b trial combining cemsidomide with elranatamab, showing enhanced CD8+ T-cell expansion and prevention of T-cell exhaustion. The 75 µg dose level was declared safe, allowing advancement to dose escalation and expansion cohorts with full data expected in mid-2027.

top.title: Calidi Biotherapeutics Received NYSE American Notification Letter Regarding Stockholders’ Equity Deficiency
top.summary: Calidi Biotherapeutics received a notice from NYSE American on September 21, 2026, indicating non-compliance with continued listing standards due to stockholders' equity deficiency of less than $4.0 million. The company has until October 21, 2026, to submit a compliance plan and must regain compliance by March 21, 2028, or face delisting proceedings. The company's stock will trade with a '.BC' designation indicating below-compliance status, though trading continues unaffected.

top.title: Debt Management Services Market Poised for Growth Through 2035, Driven by Cloud Adoption, Expanding End-User Demand and Regional Opportunities
top.summary: The global debt management services market is estimated at USD 47.17 billion and is projected to reach USD 99.9 billion by 2035, expanding at a CAGR of 7.79%. Growth is driven by rising consumer debt, increasing financial awareness, fintech innovation, and cloud adoption. gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options neutral

reasons.en: calls modestly richer than puts (+1.5 vol pts vs peers) — mild bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨略贵于看跌（+1.5 个波动点（相对同业））— 温和偏多

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: HIMS Investor Alert: Kessler Topaz Meltzer & Check, LLP Encourages HIMS Investors with Losses to Contact the Firm
top.summary: A securities fraud class action lawsuit has been filed against Hims & Hers Health, Inc. for allegedly making materially false statements about its privacy practices. The FTC accused HIMS of sharing customers' medical information with third-party advertisers including Meta and Snap, and charging consumers for prescriptions without proper consultation. The stock declined 14.73% on the news, dropping $4.32 per share to $25.00 on July 29, 2026.

top.title: HIMS Stockholders Have Rights – If You Lost Money Investing in Hims & Hers Health, Inc. Contact Robbins LLP for Information About Recovering Your Losses
top.summary: Robbins LLP announced a class action lawsuit against Hims & Hers Health, Inc. for allegedly sharing customers' protected health information with third-party advertising platforms and engaging in deceptive billing practices. The FTC filed a separate lawsuit on July 29, 2026, which triggered a 14.73% stock decline. Investors who purchased HIMS securities between August 4, 2025 and July 29, 2026 may be eligible to participate in the class action.

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: WISeKey Announces Planned Effectiveness of Redomiciliation from Switzerland to the British Virgin Islands
top.summary: WISeKey announced that its redomiciliation from Switzerland to the British Virgin Islands will become effective on October 2, 2026, through a merger with its BVI subsidiary WISeQey Corp. The company will rebrand to WISeQey to reflect its expansion into quantum-security technologies. Operations will remain headquartered in Switzerland, and shares will begin trading under the new ticker 'WQEY' on Nasdaq and SIX Swiss Exchange on October 5, 2026.

top.title: WISeKey Announces Results of Class B Share Election and Name Change of BVI Merger Subsidiary to WISeQey Corp.
top.summary: WISeKey announced the completion of its Class B share election process for its proposed cross-border merger with its British Virgin Islands subsidiary, now renamed WISeQey Corp. The election concluded on September 23, 2026, with 518 holders electing to receive WISeQey Class B shares. Upon merger completion, WISeQey will issue 5,180 Class B shares, 4,176,654 ordinary shares, and 1,819,060 Class F shares. The merger was previously approved by shareholders and remains subject to regulatory approvals and closing conditions.

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

Cloud deployment dominates with 71% share, and intelligent process automation leads automation types. Large enterprises currently control 67% of the market, though SMEs are growing fastest. top.title: Microservices in Healthcare Market Set for Strong Growth Through 2035 as Cloud Adoption, Modular Applications and Digital Transformation Unlock New Opportunities
top.summary: The global Microservices in Healthcare Market is projected to grow from $1.95 billion in 2025 to $11.11 billion by 2035, expanding at a 19.1% CAGR. Growth is driven by healthcare digital transformation, cloud adoption, interoperability demands, and AI/IoT integration. North America leads with 42% market share, while cloud-based deployment accounts for 68% of revenue. Major players include AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Epic Systems, Oracle Health, and IBM.

top.title: AI in Clinical Trials Market Set for Transformative Growth Through 2040, Unlocking Opportunities Across Trial Phases, Therapeutic Areas, End Users and Key Global Regions
top.summary: The global AI in clinical trials market is projected to expand from USD 2.09 billion in 2026 to USD 18.62 billion by 2040, growing at a 17.0% CAGR. AI applications including patient recruitment, predictive analytics, digital twins, and automation are addressing key challenges in drug development timelines and trial efficiency. Oncology represents the largest therapeutic area, while Asia-Pacific shows significant growth potential. Key players include IQVIA, Medidata, Dassault Systemes, and emerging AI companies like Deep 6 AI and AiCure.

top.title: AI Automation Market to Reach USD 2,041.82 Billion by 2035, Expanding at 31.62% CAGR as Enterprises Accelerate Intelligent Automation
top.summary: The global AI Automation Market is projected to grow from USD 131.19 billion in 2025 to USD 2,041.82 billion by 2035, with a CAGR of 31.62%. North America leads with 32.70% market share, while Asia Pacific shows the fastest growth at 33.07% CAGR. Cloud deployment dominates with 71% share, and intelligent process automation leads automation types. Large enterprises currently control 67% of the market, though SMEs are growing fastest. Key drivers include enterprise AI adoption, generative AI integration, and cloud-based solutions.

top.title: PNR 6-DAY DEADLINE ALERT: Pentair plc Investors with Substantial Losses Have Opportunity to Lead Shareholder Class Action Lawsuit Before October 2, 2026 Lead Plaintiff Deadline
top.summary: Hagens Berman has expanded a securities fraud class action lawsuit against Pentair plc, covering the period from March 11, 2025 to July 14, 2026. The lawsuit alleges that Pentair and its executives made materially false statements regarding the company's financial health and failed to disclose severe channel inventory destocking in its Pool segment. On July 14, 2026, Pentair shocked investors with a massive revenue miss ($930M vs. $1.14B forecast), slashed full-year guidance, and announced the sudden departure of its CFO after only four months. The stock plummeted 15% the following day. Investors with substantial losses have until October 2, 2026 to become lead plaintiffs.

top.title: PNR INVESTOR DEADLINE APPROACHING: Faruqi & Faruqi, LLP Reminds Pentair (PNR) Investors of Securities Class Action Lawsuit Deadline on October 2, 2026
top.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against Pentair plc alleging the company made false statements about its business prospects while failing to disclose significant inventory destocking in its Pool channel. The undisclosed destocking negatively impacted Pool segment sales by approximately $170 million and income by $105 million in Q2 2026, causing the stock to fall 15% on July 15, 2026. Investors who purchased Pentair securities between March 11, 2025 and July 14, 2026 have until October 2, 2026 to seek lead plaintiff status.

top.title: SMPL DEADLINE: ROSEN, SKILLED INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages The Simply Good Foods Company Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action – SMPL
top.summary: Rosen Law Firm is notifying investors about multiple securities class action lawsuits. The Simply Good Foods Company faces allegations of making false statements regarding its OWYN acquisition, including undisclosed loss of key personnel, product quality issues, margin erosion, and failure to achieve strategic goals. Similar class actions have been filed against Pentair plc and Datavault AI Inc., with lead plaintiff deadlines ranging from October 2-13, 2026.

top.title: PENTAIR DEADLINE: ROSEN, SKILLED INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages Pentair plc Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important October 2 Deadline in Securities Class Action - PNR
top.summary: Rosen Law Firm is notifying Pentair plc investors of an October 2, 2026 deadline to serve as lead plaintiff in a securities class action lawsuit. The lawsuit alleges that Pentair made false statements regarding its 80/20 program, which allegedly failed to improve operations, damaged customer relationships, caused loss of market share particularly in the Pool segment, and created undisclosed financial risks. gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility is already elevated — realized vol sits in the top fifth of the past year, so the move is underway, not loading. This is the opposite of a coiled squeeze: the quiet entry is already gone. A late / heads-up read, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动率已处于高位 — 实现波动率位于过去一年前五分之一，行情已在进行，而非蓄势。这与压缩蓄势相反：安静的入场点已过。属偏晚的提示读数，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean up

reasons.en: calls richer than puts by +5.0 vol pts vs peers — strong informed bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨比看跌贵 +5.0 个波动点（相对同业） — 知情资金强烈偏多

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options neutral
iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: RXT INVESTOR DEADLINE APPROACHING: Faruqi & Faruqi, LLP Reminds Rackspace Technology Investors of Securities Class Action Lawsuit Deadline on September 28, 2026
top.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against Rackspace Technology for allegedly misleading investors about the financial impact of its AI strategy, declining Public Cloud revenue, and reduced infrastructure resale business. The company reduced its full year 2026 revenue guidance by $150 million on July 9, 2026, causing its stock to fall 33.6%. The deadline to seek lead plaintiff status is September 28, 2026.

top.title: RXT DEADLINE: ROSEN, A RANKED AND LEADING LAW FIRM, Encourages Rackspace Technology, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important September 28 Deadline in Securities Class Action – RXT
top.summary: Rosen Law Firm reminds Rackspace Technology (RXT) investors who purchased securities between May 7, 2026 and July 8, 2026 of the September 28, 2026 lead plaintiff deadline in an ongoing securities class action. The lawsuit alleges that Rackspace made false statements regarding its enterprise AI efforts, declining Public Cloud revenue, and materially misleading statements about business prospects and fiscal year 2026 revenue projections.

top.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges Rackspace Technology, Inc. Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
top.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Rackspace Technology, Inc. alleging that company executives made materially false and misleading statements regarding business operations and financial condition during May-July 2026. The complaint claims Rackspace failed to disclose that enterprise AI efforts would require significant reallocation of resources from its profitable Private Cloud segment, that Public Cloud revenue was declining, and that fiscal year 2026 revenue would be significantly impacted. Investors who purchased Rackspace securities during the class period are encouraged to join the lawsuit.

reasons.zh: 多头 Gamma — 做市商对冲抑制波动

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean down

reasons.en: puts richer than calls by -3.4 vol pts vs peers — protection strongly bid
reasons.zh: 看跌比看涨贵 -3.4 个波动点（相对同业） — 保护性看跌被大力买入

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: Enzyme Replacement Therapy Market to Grow to USD 27.90 Billion by 2035 at a CAGR of 8.59% - SNS Insider
top.summary: The global Enzyme Replacement Therapy (ERT) market is projected to grow from USD 12.24 billion in 2025 to USD 27.90 billion by 2035, with a CAGR of 8.59%. Growth is driven by early identification of rare lysosomal storage disorders, increased newborn screening, orphan drug incentives, and expanding healthcare access. North America leads with 38.76% market share, while Asia-Pacific shows the fastest growth at 9.43% CAGR. Imiglucerase dominates products, and Gaucher disease represents the largest therapeutic condition.

top.title: Suja Life Investor News: If You Have Suffered Losses in Suja Life, Inc., You Are Encouraged to Contact The Rosen Law Firm About Your Rights
top.summary: The Rosen Law Firm is investigating potential securities claims against Suja Life, Inc. (NASDAQ: SUJA) for allegedly issuing materially misleading business information. The company lowered its full-year sales outlook to $360-369 million due to softer grocery bookings, causing the stock to fall 46% on August 5, 2026. Investors who purchased Suja securities may be eligible for compensation through a class action lawsuit.

The firm is also investigating potential breaches of fiduciary duties at BellRing Brands, Inc. and securities claims against Suja Life, Inc. Affected investors are encouraged to join prospective class actions for potential compensation.

top.title: Enzyme Replacement Therapy Market to Grow to USD 27.90 Billion by 2035 at a CAGR of 8.59% - SNS Insider
top.summary: The global Enzyme Replacement Therapy (ERT) market is projected to grow from USD 12.24 billion in 2025 to USD 27.90 billion by 2035, with a CAGR of 8.59%. Growth is driven by early identification of rare lysosomal storage disorders, increased newborn screening, orphan drug incentives, and expanding healthcare access. North America leads with 38.76% market share, while Asia-Pacific shows the fastest growth at 9.43% CAGR. Imiglucerase dominates products, and Gaucher disease represents the largest therapeutic condition.

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean down

reasons.en: puts richer than calls by -6.6 vol pts vs peers — protection strongly bid
reasons.zh: 看跌比看涨贵 -6.6 个波动点（相对同业） — 保护性看跌被大力买入

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: Veracyte Announces Eight Decipher-Focused Studies to Be Presented at ASTRO 2026

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility is already elevated — realized vol sits in the top fifth of the past year, so the move is underway, not loading. This is the opposite of a coiled squeeze: the quiet entry is already gone. A late / heads-up read, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动率已处于高位 — 实现波动率位于过去一年前五分之一，行情已在进行，而非蓄势。这与压缩蓄势相反：安静的入场点已过。属偏晚的提示读数，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean up

reasons.en: calls richer than puts by +13.3 vol pts vs peers — strong informed bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨比看跌贵 +13.3 个波动点（相对同业） — 知情资金强烈偏多

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean down

reasons.en: puts richer than calls by -13.4 vol pts vs peers — protection strongly bid
reasons.zh: 看跌比看涨贵 -13.4 个波动点（相对同业） — 保护性看跌被大力买入

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.summary: WISeKey announced the completion of its Class B share election process for its proposed cross-border merger with its British Virgin Islands subsidiary, now renamed WISeQey Corp. The election concluded on September 23, 2026, with 518 holders electing to receive WISeQey Class B shares. Upon merger completion, WISeQey will issue 5,180 Class B shares, 4,176,654 ordinary shares, and 1,819,060 Class F shares. The merger was previously approved by shareholders and remains subject to regulatory approvals and closing conditions.

top.title: YYForce 公佈 2026 年上半年財務業績，收益增長 26.8% 至 3,270 萬美元
top.summary: YYForce Inc. (Nasdaq: YFOR) reported H1 2026 revenue of $32.7 million, up 26.8% year-over-year, driven by 62.4% growth in manpower outsourcing to $15.6 million and 11.1% growth in integrated facility management to $16.1 million. However, gross margin compressed from 16.6% to 10.1% due to rising labor costs. Net loss narrowed 13.8% to $7.1 million. The company withdrew its 2026 full-year guidance citing labor cost pressures and outlined its 2030 vision to integrate AI, automation, and robotics into its workforce management platform.

top.title: YYForce publie les résultats financiers de son premier semestre 2026, faisant apparaître un chiffre d’affaires établi à 32,7 millions de dollars, en croissance de 26,8 %
top.summary: YYForce Inc. (Nasdaq: YFOR), formerly YY Group Holding Limited, reported H1 2026 revenue of $32.7 million, up 26.8% year-over-year, driven by 62.4% growth in manpower outsourcing to $15.6 million and 11.1% growth in integrated facility management to $16.1 million. Net loss decreased 13.8% to $7.06 million. The company unveiled its 'Vision YYForce 2030' strategy to evolve into an integrated workforce solutions provider combining AI, robotics, and human workers. However, gross margins contracted from 16.6% to 10.1% due to rising labor costs, prompting the company to withdraw its 2026 guidance.

top.title: YYForce veröffentlicht die Finanzergebnisse für das erste Halbjahr 2026 und verzeichnet ein Umsatzwachstum von 26,8 % auf 32,7 Millionen US-Dollar
top.summary: YYForce Inc. (Nasdaq: YFOR) meldete für das erste Halbjahr 2026 einen Umsatz von 32,7 Millionen US-Dollar (+26,8% YoY), angetrieben durch 62,4% Wachstum im Personal-Outsourcing-Segment. Allerdings sank die Bruttogewinnmarge von 16,6% auf 10,1% aufgrund höherer Arbeitskosten. Das Unternehmen verbesserte seine Bilanz mit einem Betriebskapital von 11,9 Millionen US-Dollar und reduzierte Gesamtverbindlichkeiten um 39%. YYForce kündigte seine 'Vision 2030' an, um ein integriertes Arbeitsökosystem mit KI, Robotik und Automatisierung aufzubauen.

top.title: ROSEN, RECOGNIZED INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages York Space Systems Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action – YSS
top.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against York Space Systems Inc. (NYSE: YSS) alleging that the company made materially false and misleading statements about its satellite software functionality. According to the lawsuit, York Space's onboard mission and payload software was not fully functional before satellites were launched, and the company allegedly deceived the Pentagon's Space Development Agency with false advertising. Investors who purchased YSS securities during the class period (January 29, 2026 - May 11, 2026) or through the IPO registration statement are encouraged to join the class action before the October 30, 2026 lead plaintiff deadline.

top.title: Robbins LLP Urges YSS Stockholders with Significant Losses to Contact the Firm for Information About the Securities Class Action Against York Space Systems Inc.
top.summary: A securities class action has been filed against York Space Systems Inc. (NYSE: YSS) alleging the company misled investors about its ability to maintain contracts with the Pentagon's Space Development Agency. The complaint claims York failed to disclose that satellite software was not fully functional before launch and that the SDA halted third tranche payments in favor of a new Space Data Network. York's stock fell approximately $7 on May 11, 2026, following a Wolfpack Research report detailing these issues. Investors with losses between January 29 and May 11, 2026, may be eligible to participate in the lawsuit.
